insert all into FX_IMIX_MEM_INFO ( SEQNO, JYCYID, JGDM, JYCYQC, ZWJC, YWQC, YWJC, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME,ZWJCSZM )
select SEQNO, JYCYID, JGDM, JYCYQC, ZWJC, YWQC, YWJC, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME,ZWJCSZM from
select #{items.id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as SEQNO, #{items.jycyid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as JYCYID, #{items.jgdm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as JGDM, #{items.jycyqc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as JYCYQC, #{items.zwjc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as ZWJC , #{items.ywqc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as YWQC, #{items.ywjc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as YWJC , 'BATCH' as CREATORID , NOW() as CREATEDTIME,
(case when #{items.zwjc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = null then null else (select upper(F_TRANS_PINYIN_CAPITAL (#{items.zwjc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) as XM from dual) end ) AS ZWJCSZM from dual

insert all into FX_IMIX_MEM_MAIL_INFO ( SEQNO, JYCYID, JYCY, JYYID, JYYXM, LXDH, CZ, EMAIL, MSN, TXDZ, YZBM, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME,JYYXMSZM )
SELECT SEQNO, JYCYID, JYCY, JYYID, JYYXM, LXDH, CZ, EMAIL, MSN, TXDZ, YZBM, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME, JYYXMSZM FROM
Select #{items.id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS SEQNO, #{items.jycyid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JYCYID, #{items.jycy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JYCY, #{items.jyyid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JYYID, #{items.jyyxm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JYYXM, #{items.lxdh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS LXDH, #{items.cz,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CZ, #{items.email,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS EMAIL, #{items.msn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS MSN, #{items.txdz,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TXDZ, #{items.yzbm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS YZBM, 'BATCH' AS CREATORID, NOW() AS CREATEDTIME, (case when #{items.jyyxm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = null then null else (select upper(F_TRANS_PINYIN_CAPITAL(#{items.jyyxm,jdbcType=VARCHAR})) as XM from dual) end ) AS JYYXMSZM from dual
